tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
ATFLOR Air Grommet is a premium raised-floor accessory designed to improve cable management and airflow efficiency in data centers, server rooms, telecom facilities, and IT offices. Engineered for professional raised-floor installations, the Air Grommet ensures neat cable routing while preventing air leakage under the floor, enhancing cooling efficiency and protecting sensitive equipment.


Available at D CORE, this high-quality grommet is an essential component for every modern raised-floor system.


Key Features

  • Optimized Cable Management: Organizes power and data cables, keeping them neat and accessible.
  • Airflow Seal / Reduced Leakage: Prevents bypass airflow under raised floors, improving HVAC efficiency and cooling of servers and electronics.
  • Durable Construction: Built to withstand commercial and industrial usage with long-term reliability.
  • Standard Size & Fit: Designed to fit standard raised floor panels for easy installation.
  • Enhanced Equipment Safety: Minimizes the risk of cable damage and static discharge in IT environments.
